copy.tagline: 用 Apigee 策略防范 API 安全威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google Apigee 上加强 API 防护
copy.tagline_en: Protect API endpoints using Apigee threat protection policies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to strengthen API protection on Google Apigee

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你使用 Google Apigee 配置安全策略，包括 JSON/XML 威胁防护、OAuth 2.0、SpikeArrest 速率限制、正则表达式防注入和 API 密钥验证。它还会帮你部署和验证这些策略。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 Apigee 安全防护、需要部署威胁防护策略、或进行安全评估时触发。

say.text: 使用 Apigee 为我的 API 添加 JSON 威胁防护。
配置 SpikeArrest 防止流量激增。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides you to configure security policies in Google Apigee, including JSON/XML threat protection, OAuth 2.0, SpikeArrest rate limiting, regex injection prevention, and API key validation. It also helps deploy and verify these policies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Apigee security, need to deploy threat protection policies, or conduct security assessments.

say_en.text: Add JSON threat protection to my API using Apigee.
say_en.note: Claude provides a JSONThreatProtection policy example.

say_en.text: Configure SpikeArrest to prevent traffic spikes.
say_en.note: Claude shows SpikeArrest policy and rate settings.
